requirements_summary: Scale: index ~120M documents (mixed PDF/Word/HTML), peak QPS target 1k (search front-end), 95th tail latency goal <250ms for top-k retrieval+rerank. Cost sensitivity: target ~$0.03-0.08 per query in steady state. Reranking: lightweight on-prem transformer preferred (quantized), fallback to smaller CPU models for lower tiers. Embeddings: prefer local float16/INT8 embeddings generation and storage; strict key management (customer KMS/HSM). Data residency: full on-prem, air-gapped environment; no external egress allowed. Integration: ingest connectors to legacy ECM (SharePoint 2013), NARA-style retention tagging, audit trail per query.
